text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle comes to watch the Arima 
Kinen. Today's lineup includes Symboli 
Kris S, fresh off her Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting cocky, thinking they might have 
put up a good fight if only they had 
entered the race. But once the gate 
opened—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S seized an effortless 
victory with running she could never hope 
to match. It served as a stark reminder of 
the vast gulf that still separated their 
brilliance and ambition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could she truly keep up with all of this 
going forward? Hishi Miracle was seized by 
intense anxiety.
